test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following musicians is associated with the instrument santoor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma** is an **Indian classical musician** and a renowned **Santoor player.**
 
• Under the pseudonym **Shiv–Hari**, he worked as a music composer with Indian flautist **Hariprasad Chaurasia**, creating scores for popular Indian movies like **Faasle (1985), Chandni (1989), and Lamhe (1991).**
 
• In addition to the **Padma Shri and Padma Vibhushan** in **1991 and 2001**, Sharma received the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in **1986.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alauddin Khan **was a Hindustani classical musician who played various instruments including the** Sarod.**

 
 
• In **1958 and 1971**, Khan received the **Padma Bhushan and the Padma Vibhushan,** respectively.
 
 
 
• **Annapurna Devi** was also an Indian classical musician who played the **Surbahar,** a stringed instrument.
 
 
• **Maharaja Brijnath Singh** of the erstwhile Maihar Estate gave her the name "Annapurna," and this was the name by which she was commonly recognized.
 
• She was **Ustad Ali Akbar Khan's sister **and the disciple and** daughter of Allauddin Khan**.
 
 
 
• **Vilayat Khan** was a **sitar player** and one of the most famous musicians in the Indian classical music industry.
 
 
• He is recognized as having contributed to the invention and advancement of** gayaki ang on the sitar,** along with Imdad Khan, Enayat Khan, and Imrat Khan.
